requirements.requirement: Create a local certificate authority named 'OS Comparison Root CA' on node1
requirements.summary: Executor generated a 4096-bit RSA key and self-signed X.509 root CA at /etc/pki/CA/os-comparison-root-ca/rootCA.crt with subject/issuer CN=OS Comparison Root CA, O=OS Comparison, OU=Root CA, 10-year validity, confirmed via openssl x509 -subject -issuer -dates.

requirements.requirement: Install the CA certificate as a trusted system certificate authority
requirements.summary: CA cert copied to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/, update-ca-trust extract run, confirmed as a trust anchor via 'trust list' and present in the extracted tls-ca-bundle.pem. Functional trust further confirmed by signing a leaf certificate and successfully verifying it against the default system trust store with openssl verify.

overall_summary: Both material outcomes of the task — creating a self-signed root CA named 'OS Comparison Root CA' and installing it as a trusted system CA on node1 — are directly and satisfactorily evidenced: the CA was generated with correct subject/issuer, added to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/, extracted via update-ca-trust, confirmed as a trust anchor, and functionally validated by successfully verifying a CA-signed leaf certificate against the system trust store. The executor additionally ran the independent provider-wide node-restart evidence protocol, showing a healthy pre-reboot baseline, a reboot acknowledgement, a changed boot_id (dfdea52d... to 9b262cfe...) and uptime post-reboot, and confirmed the CA trust anchor and functional trust persisted after the restart — a clean, complete restart evidence chain even though restart/persistence was not itself part of the public task contract.
limitations: Restart/persistence was not part of the public task contract, so the restart evidence is treated as supplemental context rather than a scored task requirement, though it strengthens confidence in the durability of the CA installation.

The 'trust list' grep-based check and bundle grep are text-matching confirmations rather than a full certificate-chain validation, though the subsequent openssl verify against the leaf certificate provides stronger functional proof.

operational_hygiene.summary: Test leaf certificates and CSRs generated to prove functional trust were cleaned up immediately (cmd-7964bcdf748a405a removed pre-reboot leaf artifacts; the post-reboot leaf test in cmd-ba06f44022ef4825 self-cleaned via its trailing rm). The CA key/cert directory at /etc/pki/CA/os-comparison-root-ca/ is retained, which is expected and necessary as the CA's operational material. The provider-wide restart protocol (not part of the public task contract) left one small residual file, /tmp/reboot.log, from the backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' redirect (cmd-67a4e30c52f546b5); this is low-risk, bounded, and harmless residue rather than a security-relevant mutation. No failed services, no unsafe exposure, no package-state damage, and listening sockets are unchanged in composition across the reboot (only PIDs differ).
